title: U.S. Rural Road Fatality County Panel, 2015-2024
description:
Open county-by-year panel of U.S. fatal motor vehicle crashes and deaths, 2015-2024, built from NHTSA's Fatality Analysis Reporting System (FARS). Deaths are split by rural and urban location (2020 Census urban areas, held fixed across years, and the FARS RUR_URB label), road class, road owner, and person type (driver, passenger, pedestrian, cyclist). Includes Census population, 2020 rural population, 2024 FHWA HPMS public road miles by functional class and ownership, a crash-level crosswalk to 2020 Census places and county subdivisions with match flags, a codebook, join rules, a provenance log with SHA-256 fingerprints, a QA report, and validation tables comparing the FARS rural label with Census urban areas.

FARS 2015-2023 are Final Files; 2024 is the Annual Report File.
